name: @chewygumxx/skill-managing-dotfiles-with-chezmoi
description: Changes, templates and applies a home directory's dotfiles through chezmoi's source directory, checking each change before it lands. Use when adding, changing, templating, applying or debugging dotfiles managed by chezmoi: its source directory and attribute-named files (dot_, private_, run_onchange_, .tmpl), .chezmoiignore, externals, scripts, secrets and encryption, the chezmoi config file, or setting up a machine from a dotfiles repo with chezmoi init.
